votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of Tuesday, June 9, 2020
votes.description: The Council approved the official work session meeting minutes from June 9, 2020.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 6 of 2021 Designating the First Monday in March as COVID-19 Victims and Survivors Memorial Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall designating March 1st (the first Monday in March) as COVID-19 Victims and Survivors Memorial Day in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearings and refer Items 1-8 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: The Council closed the combined public hearing for eight grant applications and referred them to a future consent agenda for formal action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Bond Resolution for the Department of Airports short-term borrowing program
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on a bond resolution authorizing a short-term borrowing program (up to $300,000,000 revolving line of credit via JPMorgan Chase) for the benefit of the Department of Airports.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 2 of 2021, adopting changes related to modular building construction and inspections
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance amending Salt Lake City Code Sections 18.08.040 and 18.32.020 to allow off-site inspection of modular or factory-built structures, providing a process for permitting, inspecting, and approving these buildings.

votes.motion: Approve an appropriations resolution (Resolution 8 of 2021) updating the 2020-2021 action plan as set forth in Exhibit A for Volunteers of America application ESG #4
votes.description: The Council approved the portion of the HUD CARES Act grant appropriations resolution specifically covering the Volunteers of America ESG #4 application, with Councilmember Johnston recused.

votes.motion: Authorize an interlocal agreement between the City and HUD and approve an appropriations resolution (Resolution 8 of 2021) updating the 2020-2021 action plan as set forth in Exhibit A awarding CDBG, ESG, and HOPWA funds except for ESG #4
votes.description: The Council authorized an interlocal agreement with HUD and approved appropriations of CARES Act CDBG-CV, ESG-CV, and HOPWA grant funds to eligible community partners, excluding the ESG #4 item voted on separately.

votes.motion: Adopt joint Resolution 7 of 2021 applauding the work of the Salt Lake City Hostage Negotiation Team and Director Jessica Waters
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing the dedicated work, compassion, and successful de-escalation efforts of the Salt Lake City Police Department Hostage Negotiation Team and Director Jessica Waters.

The Council approved the consent agenda including setting public hearing dates for a rezone, library budget amendment, and off-street parking zoning text amendments, and approving board appointments for Shelley Bodily and José Organista to the Housing Trust Fund Advisory Board and the reappointment of Dave Alderman to the Transportation Advisory Board.
